svg.aria-label: Original cozy timber and brick pixel-art corner-unit floorplan with planted balcony, covered porch, interior entrance and stairs to one garage below
svg.metadata: Original Stardew-inspired pixel-art room and garden illustration. It borrows only general cozy timber, brick, foliage and craft aesthetics; no reference-image pixels or game sprites are copied. The exact second-floor v8 corner-unit footprint and pin geometry are preserved. Planted balcony and covered porch are left; Entry remains inside; porch stairs lead to one single-car garage below. No garage is added to the floorplan or beside the house. Lane above, street frontage left, attached neighbor right, planted pedestrian edge below. No addresses, street names, unit numbers, logos or room labels. Editable SVG and clean lossless PNG; motion belongs to the separate live dashboard overlays.
